# v0.10.0 beta — C++ renderer candidate

This candidate moves enhanced rendering into a standalone C++ DLL while
retaining the loading-performance fix from v0.9.2, including the fix for systems
that fell to around 200 DOSBox cycles during loading.

- Native rendering and HUD with a privately linked FreeType library.
- Smaller Python dependency set: Python remains for input, gameplay fixes,
  and configuration, without NumPy, Numba, or the Python OpenGL renderer.
- Restored 72 FPS launcher alongside 30 FPS, 60 FPS, and 60fps_maxcycles.
- HUD damage-wireframe scaling, mission/configuration fixes, and improved
  context/resource cleanup from the integrated release foundations.

Extract into a fresh directory. To migrate settings, copy only
`mw2mods/mod.conf` and, if present, `mw2mods/joystick.conf` from the previous
installation. Do not copy its Python environment or renderer files. Keep the
previous installation available as a fallback. Add your own game files as
described in README.md.

This is an unpublished candidate. Renderer releases remain beta until v1.0.0.
